title: Observable inverse by support-growth damping
initial_obstruction: Global mixing can be arbitrarily slow although a requested observable has a bounded Poisson response.
initial_generic_gate: An unbiased stationary-mean estimator from transition simulation alone with finite work and variance independent of rare transitions.
surviving_operation: Compile locally given generator relations into unbiased stationary-moment and Poisson-function evaluations by sampling a single random symbolic path.

input.state_space: A finite state space, possibly exponentially large and not enumerated.
input.generator: A continuous-time Markov generator L, given by exact local rules.
input.basis: Bounded functions phi_i, evaluable at a requested x, with an integer grade g(i).
input.relation: L phi_i = -d_i phi_i + c_i 1 + sum_j b_ij phi_j.
input.row_access: Exact d_i and c_i, exact outgoing coefficient sum, and sampling j proportional to abs(b_ij).
input.structural_gate: For every outgoing nonzero b_ij, g(j) >= g(i)+1; sum_j abs(b_ij)/d_i <= A/(g(i)+1); d_i >= gamma > 0; abs(c_i)/d_i <= U.
input.acquisition_boundary: The relations and their global validity must be derived from the local rules. A full Poisson solution is not supplied. Costs of basis discovery, coefficient extraction, grade verification, and exact row sampling remain separately charged.

output.stationary_moment: An unbiased estimator of pi(phi_i), valid for every stationary pi, with magnitude <= U exp(A).
output.poisson_evaluation: An unbiased estimator of h_i(x) satisfying -L h_i = phi_i - pi(phi_i), with magnitude <= exp(A)/gamma.
output.work: Expected A+1 symbolic row visits, plus terminal function evaluation and all acquisition costs.
output.accuracy: Averages/median of means require O(exp(2A)/(gamma^2 epsilon^2) log(1/delta)) evaluations for a Poisson value to absolute error epsilon.

proved_example: A nonlinear feedforward spin chain with fresh independent passive spins and an arbitrarily slow hidden control spin. The observable evolution depends on that slow spin, but support growth gives a factorially convergent inverse with no inverse-slow-rate factor.
hard_surviving_gate: Acquire such a bounded local basis for an important model with feedback, reused degrees of freedom, or nonlinear interaction. Fresh passive inputs give an internally proved family but do not establish applicability to equilibrium interacting systems or universal simulation.
prior_art_boundary: Weighted Neumann random walks, stochastic duality, finite moment closure, and auxiliary-function bounds are established. The specific graded envelope and bounded Poissonized estimator are reconstructed here; their originality is UNKNOWN.
not_established: A universal estimator independent of mixing
A new general method beyond weighted Neumann or stochastic duality
A polynomial basis-acquisition theorem for important feedback models
